        wallet_balance_before = cursor.fetchone()[0]
        
        cursor.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "transaction"')

        traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    try:
        options = ChromeOptions()

        driver.find_element(By.ID, "remarks").send_keys("Rent")
        driver.find_element(By.ID, "transfer-money").click()

                        if "col-status" in cell.get_attribute("class"):

                            else:

                        if "col-reference" in cell.get_attribute("class"):

        transaction_row = cursor.fetchone()
        
        if transaction_row:
            if transaction_row[0] == "CUST-W001":

Your prompts were specific and grounded in your test design, and you successfully verified all expected outcomes including balance changes, transaction records, and error messages. The automation is well-structured with proper error handling and cleanup. Minor improvement opportunity: consider using explicit waits instead of fixed sleeps for more robust synchronization, though your current approach works reliably.
